//paths: Cleared, deliberately. tsconfig.json maps @iris/core to the core's SOURCE so the editor and `npm run typecheck` follow it straight into the real file. The emit cannot do that: rootDir is src/, and a mapping to ../packages/iris-core/src makes tsc try to compile files outside it ("is not under rootDir"). With no mapping it resolves through node_modules, where the file: dependency links the built package, so the core is an ordinary external import and is emitted as a require() the packaged app resolves at runtime. The core must therefore be BUILT before this runs — see the build:core step in the workflows.
